title: Laser Hair Removal Marketing | Package & Membership Growth | Plastix

facts.fact: Laser hair removal requires 6-8 sessions spaced weeks apart for permanent results, according to Plastix's page.
facts.quote: Laser hair removal requires 6-8 sessions for permanent results.

facts.fact: Plastix states that its average 6-session laser hair removal package value is $2,400 or more.
Plastix states that 85% of revenue should come from packages for laser hair removal practices (its own stated target, not sourced data).
Plastix states that hair removal searches spike 73% between March and June as patients prepare for summer (vendor's own figure, source not given).
facts.quote: Hair removal searches spike 73% between March and June as patients prepare for summer.

facts.fact: Plastix states that 40% of laser hair removal patients never schedule a second session after their first appointment (vendor's own claim, source not given).
facts.quote: You book session one, but 40% of patients never schedule session two.

facts.fact: Plastix claims a practice loses $2,000 or more in revenue per patient who drops off after one laser hair removal appointment (vendor's own estimate).
facts.quote: You're losing $2,000+ in revenue per patient who drops off after one appointment.

facts.fact: Plastix describes competitors offering $99 full-body laser hair removal sessions through Groupon, LivingSocial, and Instagram ads.
facts.quote: Groupon. LivingSocial. Instagram ads offering $99 full-body sessions.

facts.fact: Plastix recommends winter pre-booking campaigns that lock in spring appointments and package purchases 2-3 months before peak demand.
facts.quote: Winter email and ad campaigns that lock in spring appointments and package purchases 2-3 months before peak demand

facts.fact: Plastix describes packages as 6-session bundles sold at a committed price, with memberships as monthly payments that include annual touch-up access.
Plastix names the Candela GentleMax Pro and Cynosure Elite iQ as laser platforms that clinics commonly invest in for hair removal.
facts.quote: You invested in a Candela GentleMax Pro or a Cynosure Elite iQ
